_method: Live https://tale-forge.app/ (sv). After load + 2.5 s, all running animations paused at currentTime 0. .tt clicked via element.click(); every CSSTransition from document.getAnimations() paused and seeked to t = i*1000/60 ms (i=0..30). getComputedStyle sampled per frame. Snap/fade: each element's computed value of 11 properties before click, at t=0 after click, and after t=500 ms; "snap" = already at final value at t=0; "fade" = still at the initial value at t=0 (includes inherited colour). Tool: scratchpad tools/theming/crossfade.js.
